numbers.source_quote: 2025 年职工薪酬金额为 8,154.92 万元
2025 年固定资产折旧金额为 2,504.15 万元
公司营业收入同比增长 25.04% 和 215.86%

key_points.point: The four-period ex-non-recurring attributable net profit series is 3,707.31 / 1,860.10 / -3,841.06 / 3,894.93 万元; the '2025 loss' statement is made under the EX-NON-RECURRING attributable-net-profit definition (that measure was -3,841.06 万元 in 2025)

2025 loss drivers: raw-material price rises plus capacity ramp-up at the Hefei and Ruyuan projects (materials, depreciation, labor) compressing gross margin, and higher period expenses; 2025 staff costs 8,154.92 万元 (+1,515.03 万元, +22.82%), fixed-asset depreciation 2,504.15 万元 (+579.24 万元, +30.09%)
Q1 2026 ex-non-recurring attributable net profit 3,894.93 万元, up 995.39% year-on-year, above the comparable-company average of 146.83%
Revenue growth: +25.04% for FY2025 vs +215.86% for Q1 2026 - a full year and a single quarter are different periods and the two rates cannot be directly compared or interchanged

'The loss is phase-specific and temporary' and 'the adverse impact will not persist' are the company's own judgments (attributed statements); the return-dilution remedies explicitly do not constitute a profit forecast

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 2025 年职工薪酬金额为 8,154.92 万元
公司营业收入同比增长 25.04% 和 215.86%

notes: Definition and period alignment are the crux: (1) the '2025 loss' is anchored to the ex-non-recurring measure - dropping the qualifier or restating it as an attributable-net-profit loss is a definition error (K1); (2) losing the minus sign on N3 loses points; (3) 25.04% (FY2025) and 215.86% (Q1 2026) belong to different periods - mixing them fails K4; (4) 995.39% is the company's own growth and 146.83% the peer average - subject confusion loses points; (5) 'phase-specific and temporary' is a company assertion, not a fact (K5). The four-number series tests position alignment: only the third period (2025) is negative. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
